description: menu.pick_next novelty quota implements a different formula than REQ-M3(v) specifies. Spec: 'at least 10% of picks across history must be (category, platform) tuples not present in history; the quota is enforced by occasionally promoting a novelty-eligible item over the strict argmax pick.' Implementation: checks 'unique_recent / 10 < novelty_ratio' over last 10 history rows — i.e. measures recent-pick UNIQUENESS, not the running ratio of novel picks. Two bugs: (1) numerator is wrong (should count novelty-eligible picks, not unique tuples); (2) the test test_novelty_key_is_category_platform_tuple only asserts 'result is not None', i.e. tautology, so the bug ships silently. PROP-M3-pick-next, PROP-novelty-key-aligned (required:true) both effectively unverified.

evidence.snippet:
novelty_ratio = float(menu.get("novelty_quota_ratio", 0.1))
novel_items = [c for c in candidates if _is_novelty_eligible(c, history)]
if novel_items and len(history) >= 10:
    recent_picks = [(h.get("category"), h.get("platform")) for h in history[-10:]]
    unique_recent = len(set(recent_picks))
    if unique_recent / 10 < novelty_ratio:
        return novel_items[0]
